SubHeading: 99acres verification team physically visit the property & check the below details

KeyPoints.Site verification: We verify the property type and configuration details -bedrooms, bathrooms, balconys & other interior features semi permanent in nature

KeyPoints.Property advertiser: We also verify the advertisers contact details

FooterHeading: You are advised to get the advertised property details verified independently
